newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says some Q1 negatives not seen ongoing.
newsitem.headline: P&U says some Q1 negatives not seen ongoing.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Wednesday that some of the negative factors impacting its first quarter result were not seen adversely affecting coming quarters.
"We don't give detailed forecasts. There are fair amounts of uncertainty (for the rest of the year)," P&U's chief financial officer Bob Salisbury told reporters on a telephone conference call.
"Some of the factors (that have hit earnings and sales in Q1) will moderate and not have as adverse an effect on results in following quarters."
P&U announced earlier that sales fell six percent in the first quarter of 1997 and earnings per share before non-recurring items were expected to drop by about 16 percent.
The company said the sales shortfall was due to adverse currency movements and customer inventory adjustments after a strong final quarter in 1996.
P&U will release its quarterly results on April 29.
